aggregateIncludes: Actual owned Native/Core/renderer/WebView/model/worker descendants, other application background work, model mappings, KV/activations/tokenizer/runtime/workspace and caches. These are whole application targets, never a3GiB worker plus additional Core/UI.

measurementDefinitions.A: Sum actual application-process WorkingSetSize, including mapped/file-backed/shared pages; sum shared pages conservatively rather than inventing perfect deduplication.
measurementDefinitions.B: Sum actual application-process PrivateUsage/committed private bytes plus complete read-only mapped model-artifact spans reserved for active models; this conservatively includes model pages even when not resident. Do not add the full model file again to A.
measurementDefinitions.planningFootprint: max(A,B), measured for the whole owned application and separately for the model job. Keep A/B/private commit/mapped bytes individually; neither equals model file length. Any unobserved child/metadata is unknown, not zero.
measurementDefinitions.peaks: Record actual available polling/high-water metrics and sampling interval/gaps. Sampled RSS maximum is not a mathematical continuous peak; retain uncertainty.

windowsJobMeaning.OSCommitControl: JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_JOB_MEMORY/PROCESS_MEMORY limits committed virtual/private memory in the job/process, not total RSS, OS file-backed mappings or complete machine physical RAM.
windowsJobMeaning.notClaimed: No OS-enforced hard RSS/file-backed/whole-application physical cap is claimed. Whole-app footprint targets use conservative admission plus observation/cancel/unload and actual acceptance evidence; transient overshoot or unknown coverage is retained, not rounded down.

admission.chosenAggregate: 2GiB preferred; upper3GiB only if the user explicitly selects that already-qualified budget/profile policy. Neither is proven fit on this PC now.
admission.applicationRemaining: selectedAggregate-currentMeasuredNonModelFootprint-128MiB interactive reserve must cover conservative qualified model profile incremental peak, including mapped artifacts/KV/children. If current non-model use already consumes the budget, deny/queue; no artificial assumption of a small Core/UI baseline.
admission.physicalHeadroom: Current available physical RAM must cover conservative predicted INCREMENTAL model/application growth plus max(256MiB,15% of that incremental growth). No4GiB/20%-of-total-RAM floor; do not require available RAM to cover already resident app pages again.
admission.commitHeadroom: Current system/process available commit must cover conservative predicted incremental private commit plus max(256MiB,15% of that incremental commit). Distinguish system CommitLimit-CommitTotal from per-process ullAvailPageFile.
admission.pressure: Recheck availability/commit, memory pressure and hard paging before dispatch and observe during execution. Unknown or worsening pressure queues/denies/cancels safely; do not silently enlarge the pagefile, trim another process or treat swapping as sufficient fit.
admission.profiles: Use actual same-role/model/runtime/context/batch qualified peaks plus a15% engineering reserve, not weight-size arithmetic. Caps may be reduced only if the reduced context/batch still meets required role/packet completeness; do not silently truncate necessary evidence.
admission.hostObservationLimit: Parent reported~1.7GiB free during unrelated controls; this is not a benchmark, resource admission witness or promise any tier fits. No host measurement performed for this draft.

parserModelAdmission.choice: Initially serialize expensive protected document parsing and new local model inference through the existing shared product resource authority, including across projects supervised by that Core authority.
parserModelAdmission.existingSeam: services/core-api/src/research_observatory_core/workflow_executor.py: LocalWorkerAdmission and LocalAdmissionController registration/reservation before claim. Extend the existing product composition; do not create a second generic scheduler or import planning/evaluation controls into runtime.
parserModelAdmission.reservationRule: Reserve the whole declared resource demand before claim/dispatch. An active expensive parser reservation excludes model inference and vice versa. Queue the newcomer until the prior owned work is drained and any model is unloaded; only then reobserve pressure, reauthorize and admit. Preserve manual/metadata responsiveness and the interactive reserve. Cancellation, crash and unknown cleanup cannot release a still-live reservation.
parserModelAdmission.capacityRule: Retain preferred total application 2048MiB / explicitly selected upper 3072MiB, conservative max(A,B) accounting and incremental physical/commit checks. Unknown or insufficient current parser/model growth or remaining aggregate budget denies or queues the work; do not assume it fits because a process has started or model weights are small. Any later concurrent profile requires actual joint-profile evidence and the existing policy route.
parserModelAdmission.inheritedParser: Preserve current parser principal, quality, cancellation, recovery, parser-only logon-session mutex and launcher/package/config 4096MiB private-commit ceiling. That ceiling is neither measured consumption nor a 4GiB RAM requirement and is not silently reduced or qualified by this W3 plan. The new aggregate admission decision may deny an unqualified workload without changing or falsely passing the old parser contract.
parserModelAdmission.authorityLimit: The current in-process ledger does not enforce reservations against unrelated Core processes. Keep the real existing Native/project exclusivity and parser mutex boundaries, and qualify the actual claimed composition. Do not infer machine-wide enforcement from a Python lock or disable another process.

Bind actual aggregate/resource observations; no current model load or larger hardware test is requested by this planning selection.
